meta.name: agf-deploying-uat
meta.description: Use when deploy-engineer is about to deploy the merged-to-main code to the isolated local UAT stack (after code review + SIT Audit pass and merge, before qa-engineer runs E2E/UAT). Provides the applicability gate, pre-flight checks, isolated compose bring-up (independent project name + port offset +900), in-container migration, real-output smoke test, hand-off, and the deploy-report skeleton. Pairs with deployment.md "UAT 环境部署" contract and slash /agf-deploy-uat.

copy.tagline: 将合并后的代码部署到隔离的 UAT 环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码合并后自动部署到 UAT 环境并执行冒烟测试。
